Not your typical horror game with fancy jump scares or anything, but I think this game thrives off the coop aspect. You and your fellow crew mates go to deserted moons. Blindly following the company's guidelines. Flying out to various moons to find scrap, each scrap varying in value trying to meet the quota within 3 days. Little do you know about the mysteries and dangerous creatures lurking on these moons. After seeing the horrors of the moons you visit, you go back to company building to give back the scrap after your 3 days are up. Once you have given your scrap you can use the quota money to buy tools or ship upgrades to make your upcoming moon runs easier.

Hopefully they add achievements to the game later on. Also they should definitely add plot to the game. So then they can add an infinite run mode and a story mode to play with your friends.

PS The proximity chat makes the game extremely fun!

I absolutely love how silly R.E.P.O. is. It somehow manages to be creepy and completely unhinged at the same time. One second you’re trying to be serious and survive, and the next you’re laughing because something went horribly wrong in the funniest way possible. The physics, the chaos, and the way everything can spiral out of control make every run feel different. It doesn’t take itself too seriously, and that’s exactly what makes it so fun—perfect for laughing with friends while still getting those tense horror moments.

Lethal company is a cooperative game where you and 3 other fellows (or more if you do some modding) experience gathering loot in chaotic environments where anything can go wrong. One instance is you and a friend of yours can be talking a room away and suddenly, no one responds back. The feelings of terror, sense of responsibility, and desire for self preservation create a wonderful and unique blend with its quirky style to stand out from the rest of its competitors.
